title: Neural Networks — Shape Is Part of the Design

body:
## Shape Is Part of the Design

A model crashes even though every number is valid. One layer produced 64 values, while the next expected 128.

Tensor shape records how values are arranged: often batch size first, then features or channels. Every layer has an input shape and an output shape that must connect.

Count parameters and activation memory before training. Wider layers can learn more patterns, but they also require more data, memory, and computation.
common_mistakes: Every layer stores only words and never numbers.
Training keeps all weights fixed forever.
Adding layers guarantees a correct answer without data.

real_world_usage: Neural networks are the shared foundation of modern image, language, speech, and recommendation systems.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Shape Is Part of the Design” situation, explain Neural Networks without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
